record.paper: Induced subgraph density. IV. New graphs with the Erdős-Hajnal property

dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraph density. IV. New graphs with the Erdős-Hajnal property
dossier_meta.statement_text: For every graph $H$, there exists $d>0$ such that for every $\varepsilon\in(0,\frac{1}{2})$ and every graph $G$ with $\mathrm{ind}_{H}(G)\leq(\varepsilon^{d}\lvert G\rvert)^{\lvert H\rvert}$, there is an $\varepsilon$-restricted subset of $V(G)$ with size at least $\varepsilon^{d}\lvert G\rvert$.
dossier_meta.context_text: This 'polynomial Nikiforov' statement, introduced without external attribution, unifies Theorem 1.6 and Conjecture 1.7. A graph $H$ satisfying it is called viral; Bucić, Fox, and Pham [4] proved that having the Erdős-Hajnal property is equivalent to being viral.
